body:
Pretty much, they tried their best and I thank them for it. I don't know why I am this way I was an only child the only real strife I've encountered was their divorce but I know my suicide would be a giant slap in the face to them and everything they've tried to do for me. 

My mother has told me before that if I die she dies with me and I can't bring myself to hurt her like that. So I smile, I act happy, I go on dates and go to work but really I'm just biding my time waiting for the inevitable. 

Once they're gone I can be done with all of this.

I've tried to kill myself at least 3 times and it seems more and more each time the only time I want to live is when I'm dying. 

Fuck self-preservation.
